summary.text: Sarahana Shrestha is a member of the New York State Assembly who has represented District 103 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on the Working Families Party and Democratic lines in the November 3, 2026 general election; she is a former graphic designer.

paragraphs.text: Shrestha was born in Kathmandu, Nepal, lives in Esopus, New York, and studied computer graphics.

Her career experience includes working as a graphic designer, and she became the Ulster County co-chair for the Mid-Hudson Valley chapter of Democratic Socialists of America and a lead campaigner with the statewide Public Power NY coalition.
Shrestha assumed office on January 1, 2023, succeeding Kevin Cahill.
Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignments as Aging, Energy, Local Governments, Tourism, Parks, Arts and Sports Development, and Transportation.
